# Seattle startup Vieu launches Business Graph to map professional relationships

Seattle startup Vieu launched its Business Graph to replace cold B2B outreach with verified introductions. The 40-person company raised an $11 million seed round last October.

Seattle startup Vieu launched its Business Graph on Tuesday, a live map of trusted relationships designed to replace cold outreach with warm introductions for B2B sales, marketing, recruiting, and fundraising. The 40-person company, which raised an $11 million seed round in October 2024, has already signed more than 100 enterprise customers, including well-known brands.

### How the Business Graph maps real connections

Unlike LinkedIn, which relies on self-reported connections, the Business Graph maps relationships based on observed signals such as shared work history, co-authored research, board affiliations, and joint ventures. # Dapta Raises $6M to Bring AI Agents to Non-English Businesses

 Nicolas Rojas 

CEO

Published on: 13 October 2026

## Built for the founders AI forgot

Behind millions of businesses in the US is a founder who thinks in another language.

The roofer in Houston. The family that runs a law firm in Miami. The insurance agent in Phoenix who built a book of business one referral at a time. Their customers might speak English, Spanish, or both. But the founder learns, decides and buys in their own language.

That matters more than anyone in AI has noticed. Business owners don’t adopt technology from a settings page. They adopt it from someone they trust, who explains it in the language they think in. Almost every AI platform is sold, taught and supported in English, so these founders get AI last, if they get it at all.

We think that’s the biggest opportunity in AI right now. And we’re winning it.
